summary: A mixed day with significant legal rulings on GST compliance and vendor payments, alongside retail sector developments including PM Modi's renewed gold-buying discourage and Jio Platforms' IPO regulatory approval.

bullets.text: Delhi HC criticizes GST framework, stating it has created more problems than solutions in fake registration cases.
Jio Platforms receives regulatory approval for $3.8 billion IPO, marking major capital market milestone for Reliance subsidiary.
PM Modi reiterates Indians should avoid gold purchases unless necessary; jewellery stocks decline amid self-reliance push.
FirstCry expands quick delivery via FC Qwik, targeting 10% of online shipments to drive multichannel sales growth.
Delhi HC orders Madhya Pradesh to pay Senior Advocate fees despite state's denial of engagement claim.
